question: Which products currently have zero available stock across all stores?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, s.store_id, s.name AS store_name FROM products p JOIN store_stock ss ON p.product_id = ss.product_id JOIN stores s ON ss.store_id = s.store_id WHERE ss.qty = 0 AND p.is_active = true ORDER BY s.store_id, p.product_id

question: Identify stock records updated within the last 15 minutes before 2026-10-25 12:00:00 UTC.
sql: SELECT store_id, product_id, qty, reserved, updated_at FROM store_stock WHERE updated_at BETWEEN '2026-10-25 11:45:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' ORDER BY updated_at DESC

question: List stores that have less than 10 units in stock for each product they carry.
sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.name AS store_name, p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, ss.qty FROM stores s JOIN store_stock ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id JOIN products p ON ss.product_id = p.product_id WHERE ss.qty < 10 ORDER BY s.store_id, p.product_id

question: How many units are currently reserved in stock broken down by store?
sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.name AS store_name, SUM(ss.reserved) AS total_reserved_units FROM stores s JOIN store_stock ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name ORDER BY total_reserved_units DESC

question: For each category, what is the total available stock quantity across all stores?
sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(SUM(ss.qty),0) AS total_stock FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN store_stock ss ON p.product_id = ss.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY total_stock ASC

question: Which stores have the highest count of distinct products currently in stock?
sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.name AS store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.product_id) AS distinct_products FROM stores s JOIN store_stock ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id WHERE ss.qty > 0 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name ORDER BY distinct_products DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find products that have not had their stock quantities updated for at least one full day before the reference time.
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, MAX(ss.updated_at) AS last_stock_update FROM products p LEFT JOIN store_stock ss ON p.product_id = ss.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name HAVING MAX(ss.updated_at) < '2026-10-24 12:00:00+00' OR MAX(ss.updated_at) IS NULL ORDER BY last_stock_update NULLS FIRST

question: Which stores have stock quantities below their reserved units during the flash sale?
sql: WITH flash_sale AS (SELECT value::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS start_time FROM meta WHERE key = 'flash_sale_start') SELECT s.store_id, s.name AS store_name, SUM(ss.qty) AS total_qty, SUM(ss.reserved) AS total_reserved FROM stores s JOIN store_stock ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name HAVING SUM(ss.qty) < SUM(ss.reserved) ORDER BY total_qty ASC

question: What is the average quantity of stock available per product category in the city of 'New York'?
sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, AVG(ss.qty) AS avg_stock_qty FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN store_stock ss ON p.product_id = ss.product_id JOIN stores s ON ss.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.city = 'New York' GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY avg_stock_qty DESC

question: List all stores that have any product with zero stock but non-zero reserved quantities.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.name FROM stores s JOIN store_stock ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id WHERE ss.qty = 0 AND ss.reserved > 0 ORDER BY s.store_id

question: Which customers from 'San Francisco' placed orders in the last 7 days before 2026-10-25 12:00:00 UTC?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'San Francisco' AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-18 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' ORDER BY c.customer_id

question: Which riders are currently active and assigned to stores located in the city of 'Chicago'?
sql: SELECT r.rider_id, r.name, s.store_id, s.name AS store_name FROM riders r JOIN stores s ON r.store_id = s.store_id WHERE r.status = 'active' AND s.city = 'Chicago' ORDER BY r.rider_id

question: What is the maximum unit price of products sold per brand in orders completed before 2026-10-25 12:00:00 UTC?
sql: SELECT p.brand, MAX(oi.unit_price) AS max_unit_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.created_at < '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY max_unit_price DESC

question: Find stores in 'Los Angeles' that have the largest sum of reserved stock quantities.
sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.name AS store_name, SUM(ss.reserved) AS total_reserved FROM stores s JOIN store_stock ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id WHERE s.city = 'Los Angeles' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name ORDER BY total_reserved DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customers have placed orders paid by 'credit_card' with totals exceeding 100 in the last 30 days before the cutoff time?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.payment_mode = 'credit_card' AND o.total > 100 AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-09-25 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' ORDER BY c.customer_id

question: Compute the total quantity of all products in stock grouped by store and ordered by city alphabetically.
sql: SELECT s.city, s.store_id, s.name AS store_name, SUM(ss.qty) AS total_stock FROM stores s JOIN store_stock ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id GROUP BY s.city, s.store_id, s.name ORDER BY s.city, s.store_id

question: Which categories have the fewest total active products currently in stock across all stores?
sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.name AS category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS active_products_in_stock FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN store_stock ss ON p.product_id = ss.product_id WHERE p.is_active = true AND ss.qty > 0 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY active_products_in_stock ASC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total number of orders delivered by each rider in the last 60 days before the fixed timestamp?
sql: SELECT r.rider_id, r.name AS rider_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM riders r LEFT JOIN orders o ON r.rider_id = o.rider_id AND o.delivered_at BETWEEN '2026-08-26 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY r.rider_id, r.name ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC

question: Which stores have at least one product with reserved stock exceeding 50 units during the flash sale?
sql: WITH flash_sale AS (SELECT value::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS start_time FROM meta WHERE key = 'flash_sale_start') SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.name FROM stores s JOIN store_stock ss ON s.store_id = ss.store_id WHERE ss.reserved > 50 ORDER BY s.store_id

question: Retrieve the 20 most recent orders placed by a specific customer identified by ID.
sql: SELECT order_id, store_id, status, total, created_at FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 123 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Count the total orders delivered yesterday for each individual store.
sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS orders_delivered FROM orders WHERE date(delivered_at) = '2026-10-24' GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id;

question: List all orders that currently have a packing status.
sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, store_id, status FROM orders WHERE status = 'packing' ORDER BY created_at DESC;

question: Show the count of cancelled orders grouped by the payment mode used.
sql: SELECT payment_mode, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY payment_mode ORDER BY cancelled_orders DESC;

question: Identify stores with the highest number of open orders at present.
sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS open_orders FROM orders WHERE status IN ('placed', 'packing') GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY open_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which orders include more than four distinct order items?
sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY item_count DESC;

question: Calculate the average value of delivered orders for each city.
sql: SELECT c.city, AVG(o.total) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

question: Find orders that have not been assigned to any rider yet.
sql: SELECT order_id, store_id, status FROM orders WHERE rider_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC;

question: During the flash sale, count how many orders are placed each minute in the last hour.
sql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS minute_slot, COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-25 11:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY minute_slot ORDER BY minute_slot;

question: How many orders placed during the flash sale are currently waiting at each store?
sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS waiting_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'placed' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-25 11:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY waiting_orders DESC;

question: List all customers from 'Boston' who placed orders in the last 10 days before the cutoff timestamp.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Boston' AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-15 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' ORDER BY c.name;

question: What is the total revenue generated by each payment mode for orders delivered in the previous week?
sql: SELECT payment_mode, SUM(total) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at BETWEEN '2026-10-18 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY payment_mode ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Identify all riders currently active and assigned to stores in 'Seattle'.
sql: SELECT r.rider_id, r.name, r.status FROM riders r JOIN stores s ON r.store_id = s.store_id WHERE r.status = 'active' AND s.city = 'Seattle' ORDER BY r.name;

question: Show the average number of order items per order for orders completed in the last 30 days.
sql: SELECT AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at BETWEEN '2026-09-25 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00') GROUP BY order_id) sub;

question: Which products have been ordered more than 100 times during the last month?
sql: SELECT oi.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.qty) AS total_qty_ordered FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-09-25 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.name HAVING SUM(oi.qty) > 100 ORDER BY total_qty_ordered DESC;

question: Find stores where the sum of reserved stock is greater than 100 units during the flash sale.
sql: SELECT store_id, SUM(reserved) AS total_reserved FROM store_stock WHERE updated_at BETWEEN '2026-10-25 11:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY store_id HAVING SUM(reserved) > 100 ORDER BY total_reserved DESC;

question: List orders from the last 48 hours that contain items priced above 50 units.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.total, o.created_at FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-23 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' AND oi.unit_price > 50 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC;

question: Which customers have placed orders with payment mode 'paypal' totaling more than 200 in the last 15 days?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.payment_mode = 'paypal' AND o.total > 200 AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-10 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' ORDER BY c.name;

question: Count orders that are currently in 'placed' status per city for stores located in 'Chicago'.
sql: SELECT s.city, COUNT(o.order_id) AS placed_orders FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.status = 'placed' AND s.city = 'Chicago' GROUP BY s.city;

question: What is the minimum and maximum price of products available in stores located in 'Miami'?
sql: SELECT MIN(p.price) AS min_price, MAX(p.price) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN store_stock ss ON p.product_id = ss.product_id JOIN stores s ON ss.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.city = 'Miami' AND p.is_active = true;

question: Find stores with no orders delivered in the last 7 days.
sql: SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE store_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at BETWEEN '2026-10-18 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00') ORDER BY store_id;

question: During the flash sale, what is the average order total per store?
sql: SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_order_total FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-25 11:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY avg_order_total DESC;

question: Which orders have order items from more than two different categories?
sql: SELECT oi.order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) AS category_count FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY oi.order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.category_id) > 2 ORDER BY category_count DESC;

question: Identify the top 5 customers by total order value in the last 90 days.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-07-27 12:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Count how many orders have been assigned to riders who are currently 'inactive'.
sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_assigned_to_inactive_riders FROM orders o JOIN riders r ON o.rider_id = r.rider_id WHERE r.status = 'inactive';

question: During the flash sale, which stores have more than 50 orders currently in 'packing' status?
sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS packing_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'packing' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-25 11:00:00+00' AND '2026-10-25 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY store_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY packing_orders DESC;

question: For each store, how many riders are currently marked as idle?
sql: select s.store_id, s.name as store_name, count(r.rider_id) as idle_riders from stores s left join riders r on s.store_id = r.store_id and r.status = 'idle' group by s.store_id, s.name order by s.name

question: What is the total count of orders each rider has delivered up until the fixed timestamp?
sql: select r.rider_id, r.name, count(o.order_id) as delivered_orders from riders r left join orders o on r.rider_id = o.rider_id and o.status = 'delivered' and o.delivered_at <= '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by r.rider_id, r.name order by delivered_orders desc

question: Which riders currently have the highest number of orders out for delivery, and how many do they have?
sql: select r.rider_id, r.name, count(o.order_id) as active_deliveries from riders r join orders o on r.rider_id = o.rider_id where o.status = 'out_for_delivery' group by r.rider_id, r.name order by active_deliveries desc limit 10

question: Calculate the average delivery time in minutes for each rider for all completed deliveries in the last 30 days before the frozen timestamp.
sql: select r.rider_id, r.name, avg(extract(epoch from (o.delivered_at - o.created_at))/60) as avg_delivery_minutes from riders r join orders o on r.rider_id = o.rider_id where o.status = 'delivered' and o.delivered_at between '2026-09-25T12:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by r.rider_id, r.name order by avg_delivery_minutes asc

question: List all riders who are assigned to stores located in the city of Bengaluru.
sql: select r.rider_id, r.name, s.name as store_name from riders r join stores s on r.store_id = s.store_id where lower(s.city) = 'bengaluru' order by r.name

question: Count the number of riders assigned to each city based on their store's location.
sql: select s.city, count(r.rider_id) as total_riders from riders r join stores s on r.store_id = s.store_id group by s.city order by s.city

question: During the flash sale period from 2026-10-25 10:00 to 2026-10-25 12:00 UTC, which riders have more than one active delivery in progress?
sql: select r.rider_id, r.name, count(o.order_id) as active_deliveries from riders r join orders o on r.rider_id = o.rider_id where o.status = 'out_for_delivery' and o.created_at between '2026-10-25T10:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by r.rider_id, r.name having count(o.order_id) > 1 order by active_deliveries desc

question: During the flash sale on 2026-10-25 between 09:00 and 12:00, which stores have more active orders than idle riders?
sql: select s.store_id, s.name, count(distinct o.order_id) as active_orders, count(distinct r.rider_id) filter (where r.status = 'idle') as idle_riders from stores s left join orders o on s.store_id = o.store_id and o.status in ('placed','packing','out_for_delivery') and o.created_at between '2026-10-25T09:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' left join riders r on s.store_id = r.store_id group by s.store_id, s.name having count(distinct o.order_id) > count(distinct r.rider_id) filter (where r.status = 'idle') order by active_orders desc

question: Which stores have the highest average total order value for orders delivered in the past 90 days?
sql: select s.store_id, s.name, avg(o.total) as avg_order_value from stores s join orders o on s.store_id = o.store_id where o.status = 'delivered' and o.delivered_at between '2026-07-27T12:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by s.store_id, s.name order by avg_order_value desc limit 10

question: Find the five cities with the greatest number of active riders currently assigned to stores within those cities.
sql: select s.city, count(r.rider_id) as active_riders from riders r join stores s on r.store_id = s.store_id where r.status = 'active' group by s.city order by active_riders desc limit 5

question: Which customers placed orders during the last 15 days before the frozen timestamp and have used a payment mode of 'credit_card'?
sql: select distinct c.customer_id, c.name, c.city from customers c join orders o on c.customer_id = o.customer_id where o.payment_mode = 'credit_card' and o.created_at between '2026-10-10T12:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' order by c.name

question: Identify stores where the combined reserved stock quantity exceeds 200 units during the flash sale period.
sql: select ss.store_id, s.name, sum(ss.reserved) as total_reserved from store_stock ss join stores s on ss.store_id = s.store_id where ss.updated_at between '2026-10-25T09:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by ss.store_id, s.name having sum(ss.reserved) > 200 order by total_reserved desc

question: For each product category, what is the maximum price of active products currently in stock?
sql: select c.category_id, c.name as category_name, max(p.price) as max_active_price from categories c join products p on c.category_id = p.category_id join store_stock ss on p.product_id = ss.product_id where p.is_active = true and ss.qty > 0 group by c.category_id, c.name order by max_active_price desc

question: Which riders have delivered at least 50 orders in the last 180 days, and what is their average delivery duration?
sql: select r.rider_id, r.name, count(o.order_id) as delivered_orders, avg(extract(epoch from (o.delivered_at - o.created_at))/60) as avg_delivery_minutes from riders r join orders o on r.rider_id = o.rider_id where o.status = 'delivered' and o.delivered_at between '2026-04-28T12:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by r.rider_id, r.name having count(o.order_id) >= 50 order by delivered_orders desc

question: List all orders that contain order items from at least three distinct product categories.
sql: select o.order_id, count(distinct p.category_id) as category_count from orders o join order_items oi on o.order_id = oi.order_id join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id group by o.order_id having count(distinct p.category_id) >= 3 order by o.order_id desc limit 20

question: During the flash sale, what is the total revenue generated by each store from delivered orders?
sql: select s.store_id, s.name, sum(o.total) as total_revenue from stores s join orders o on s.store_id = o.store_id where o.status = 'delivered' and o.delivered_at between '2026-10-25T09:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by s.store_id, s.name order by total_revenue desc

question: Which customers from New York have placed orders totaling more than 500 units in the last 60 days?
sql: select c.customer_id, c.name, sum(o.total) as total_spent from customers c join orders o on c.customer_id = o.customer_id where lower(c.city) = 'new york' and o.created_at between '2026-08-26T12:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by c.customer_id, c.name having sum(o.total) > 500 order by total_spent desc

question: Find all stores in Chicago where the number of orders currently in 'placed' status exceeds 30.
sql: select s.store_id, s.name, count(o.order_id) as placed_orders from stores s join orders o on s.store_id = o.store_id where lower(s.city) = 'chicago' and o.status = 'placed' group by s.store_id, s.name having count(o.order_id) > 30 order by placed_orders desc

question: Which products have been ordered more than 150 times in total across all stores during the past 60 days?
sql: select p.product_id, p.name, sum(oi.qty) as total_ordered from products p join order_items oi on p.product_id = oi.product_id join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id where o.created_at between '2026-08-26T12:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by p.product_id, p.name having sum(oi.qty) > 150 order by total_ordered desc

question: During the flash sale, which riders assigned to Seattle stores have active deliveries exceeding 3 orders?
sql: select r.rider_id, r.name, count(o.order_id) as active_deliveries from riders r join stores s on r.store_id = s.store_id join orders o on o.rider_id = r.rider_id where lower(s.city) = 'seattle' and o.status = 'out_for_delivery' and o.created_at between '2026-10-25T09:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by r.rider_id, r.name having count(o.order_id) > 3 order by active_deliveries desc

question: Calculate the average number of products per order for all delivered orders in Houston over the last 45 days.
sql: select s.city, avg(items_per_order) as avg_products_per_order from (select o.order_id, count(oi.order_item_id) as items_per_order from orders o join order_items oi on o.order_id = oi.order_id where o.status = 'delivered' and o.delivered_at between '2026-09-10T12:00:00+00:00' and '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' group by o.order_id) sub join orders o2 on sub.order_id = o2.order_id join stores s on o2.store_id = s.store_id where lower(s.city) = 'houston' group by s.city

question: Over the last 10 days, what are the total payouts for orders marked as delivered, grouped by store and payment mode?
sql: SELECT s.name AS store_name, o.payment_mode, SUM(o.total) AS total_payout FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.delivered_at >= '2026-10-15T12:00:00+00:00' AND o.delivered_at < '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY s.name, o.payment_mode ORDER BY s.name, o.payment_mode;

question: For each rider, what is the sum of delivered order revenue they handled in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT r.name AS rider_name, SUM(o.total) AS delivered_revenue FROM riders r JOIN orders o ON r.rider_id = o.rider_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.delivered_at >= '2026-09-25T12:00:00+00:00' AND o.delivered_at < '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY delivered_revenue DESC;

question: What is the daily delivered revenue per store for the month prior to the frozen timestamp?
sql: SELECT s.name AS store_name, date_trunc('day', o.delivered_at) AS day, SUM(o.total) AS daily_revenue FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.delivered_at >= '2026-09-25T12:00:00+00:00' AND o.delivered_at < '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY s.name, day ORDER BY s.name, day;

question: Which stores have delivered revenue exceeding the average delivered revenue per store in the last 60 days?

question: For each store in Philadelphia, count the number of riders who are currently 'idle' and the total number of orders in 'placed' status as of 2026-10-25 12:00 UTC.

question: During the flash sale on 2026-10-25 from 06:00 to 10:00 UTC, which riders have more active deliveries than the average number of idle riders per store?

question: Which stores in Los Angeles have total delivered revenue exceeding the average revenue of all LA stores in September 2026?

question: During the flash sale on 2026-10-25 from 06:00 to 12:00 UTC, which stores had more orders placed than the average daily orders in the previous week?
sql: WITH flash_sale_orders AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS flash_orders FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-25T06:00:00+00:00' AND created_at < '2026-10-25T12:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY store_id), daily_avg_orders AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(daily_count) AS avg_daily_orders FROM (SELECT store_id, date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS daily_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-18T00:00:00+00:00' AND created_at < '2026-10-25T00:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY store_id, day) sub GROUP BY store_id) SELECT stores.name, f.flash_orders, d.avg_daily_orders FROM flash_sale_orders f JOIN daily_avg_orders d ON f.store_id = d.store_id JOIN stores ON stores.store_id = f.store_id WHERE f.flash_orders > d.avg_daily_orders ORDER BY (f.flash_orders - d.avg_daily_orders) DESC;

question: During the flash sale on 2026-10-25 between 09:30 and 11:30 UTC, which stores had more delivered orders than the daily average of the previous week in stores located in Seattle?

question: For each store in Nashville, what is the count of orders delivered weekly from September to October 2026?
sql: SELECT o.store_id, date_trunc('week', o.delivered_at) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.city = 'Nashville' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.delivered_at BETWEEN '2026-09-01T00:00:00+00:00' AND '2026-10-31T23:59:59+00:00' GROUP BY o.store_id, week_start ORDER BY o.store_id, week_start;

question: During the flash sale on 2026-10-25 from 07:00 to 09:30 UTC, which customers placed orders with more than 8 total items in stores located in Phoenix?
sql: SELECT o.customer_id, c.name, SUM(oi.qty) AS total_items FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.city = 'Phoenix' AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-25T07:00:00+00:00' AND '2026-10-25T09:30:00+00:00' AND o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.name HAVING SUM(oi.qty) > 8 ORDER BY total_items DESC;
